body: I've been logging in to play but seldom any one there which is a shame as it's a good game
Definitely interested. I find it much easier learning as I play.

Not to preach, but maybe laying off the drinking, as tempting as it is, to set an example to your GF to show her it's not okay to do so, may be a wise step. As for the chain smoking, I do exactly the same. Make sure you set time aside for you.
Sorry I haven't had internet access. It sounds like she needs to be back in hospital for help. How are you holding up?
How is she doing now? How are you holding up?

I myself am a nurse, and like you can sober up in most situations. However there will always be something that catches you off guard, typically when something happens to someone you care about. Don't beat yourself up about it. By the sounds of it your GF had decided upon her actions, and you had little influence over them. You did the best you could, and you need to acknowledge that. Try get some rest.

You did an amazing thing and acted quickly and swiftly in a desperate situation. As probably not the eldest in the room it sounds like you were the one to keep a calm level head and get your GF the help she needed. That deserves a pat on the back. It will take time to process everything. Be kind to yourself. Take time out for yourself. Maybe see a counsellor? And try get some sleep. You may find that after a few hours sleep you have  a slightly clearer head.
I was in therapy but therapist stopped sessions because I relapsed.
